source: Beginner short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.en: Next to our house there is a big garden.
It has olive and lemon trees.
The kids play in the garden every day.

sentences.ar: بحب أقعد تحت الشجرة وأقرا كتاب.
sentences.en: I like to sit under the tree and read a book.
The atmosphere there is quiet and nice.
